value.title: Depth of Field: Love and Hate Theater Phase I
value.synopsis: Rikka and Sanae face each other in an epic mecha battle in an apocalyptic setting. Included in the BD/DVD Vol.1

value.title: Depth of Field: Love and Hate Theater Phase II
value.synopsis: Six hours and twenty-four minutes earlier, Sanae confronts Rikka before boarding her ultimate mech, Décolleté. Included in the BD/DVD Vol.2

value.title: Depth of Field: Love and Hate Theater Phase III
value.synopsis: After dodging Sanae's advances, Rikka boards her own ultimate mech, Königin der Nacht, and returns fire. Included in the BD/DVD Vol.3

value.title: Depth of Field: Love and Hate Theater Phase IV
value.synopsis: A flashback reveals that Rikka betrayed her army because her superiors ordered her to attack civilians, before Rikka and Sanae resume the fight. Included in the BD/DVD Vol.4

value.title: Depth of Field: Love and Hate Theater Phase V
value.synopsis: While fighting, a glimpse shows Sanae and Rikka being happy together in a field, though Sanae plans to defeat them. Included in the BD/DVD Vol.5

value.title: Depth of Field: Love and Hate Theater Last Phase
value.synopsis: Sanae and Rikka end up with a final standoff, but Rikka turns off Königin der Nacht, thus losing the battle. In reality, Sanae and Rikka were just fighting in the clubroom while wearing boxes. Included in the BD/DVD Vol.6

value.title: Depth of Field: Love and Hate Theater Extra Phase
value.synopsis: Rikka imagines a scene where Sanae kidnaps Yūta Togashi, but Rikka tickles Sanae. Included in the BD/DVD Vol.7
